issue.title: fix(comments): restore rounded corners on inline video player
issue.body: Closes #4707 ## Description A previous refactor of `VideoCommentPlayer` removed its outer `ClipRRect`, which inadvertently dropped the rounded corners on inline video previews inside comment items. This PR restores the rounded corners at the caller side and includes a small cleanup on the collaborator invite card. - `comment_item.dart`: wrap `VideoCommentPlayer` in `ClipRRect(borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12))` inside the existing `Align` + `ConstrainedBox(maxWidth: 248)`, restoring the previous visual. - `collaborator_invite_card.dart`: switch `EdgeInsetsGeometry.fromSTEB` to `EdgeInsetsDirectional.fromSTEB(12, 48, 12, 12)` so padding mirrors correctly in RTL locales. - `comment_item_test.dart`: add a regression test (`wraps the inline video player with rounded corners`) that asserts the `ClipRRect` ancestor and its 12 px radius. Sets `VisibilityDetectorController.instance.updateInterval = Duration.zero` in `setUpAll` to prevent the visibility_detector timer from leaking into other tests (matches the existing pattern in `video_comment_player_test.dart` and `visibility_aware_video_test.dart`). | Before | After | | ------ | ------ | | | | **Related Issue:** N/A — follow-up to commit `a95b8d78` on this branch. ## Out of Scope None. ## Verification - `flutter test test/screens/comments/comment_item_test.dart` → 7/7 pass - `flutter analyze lib test integration_test` ## Type of Change - [x] 🛠️ Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)

issue.title: fix: videos missing after reinstall
issue.body:
### Summary

Videos do not appear in the app after reinstalling and logging back in, even though the web app still shows the user has 70 videos but also didn't show the videos itself.

### Environment

unknown

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Delete the app from the device.
2. Reinstall the app.
3. Log back into the account.
4. Open the videos/library section.

### Actual Result

The app shows no videos, while the web app still indicates that 70 videos are associated with the account.

### Expected Result

All previously uploaded or saved videos should reappear in the app after logging back in.

### Regression?

Unknown

### Evidence

Reported on discord [here](https://discord.com/channels/1470168817589158040/1470255950408454164/1508175643068858502)

issue.title: refactor: replace mediakit with the new native-video-player
issue.body:
## Description

This PR replaces the old MediaKit video-player with the new DivineVideoPlayer which uses native-video-player apis.

Additionally, this PR fixes a brief flash of the paused/play overlay that appeared when scrolling to the next video in the feed. The `PausedVideoOverlay` now debounces the promotion of its "visible & paused" latch by 300 ms, so the transient `paused + firstFrameRendered` emission a pooled controller produces during a swipe no longer triggers the play affordance. A genuinely user-paused video still shows the play button after the short delay.

Closes #4684

## Out of Scope

None.

## Verification

- `flutter analyze lib/widgets/video_feed_item/paused_video_overlay.dart test/widgets/video_feed_item/paused_video_overlay_test.dart` — clean
- `flutter test test/widgets/video_feed_item/paused_video_overlay_test.dart` — passes
- Manual: swiping between videos in the feed no longer flashes the play overlay; pausing a video manually still surfaces it.

## Type of Change

- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [x] 🛠️ Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ❌ Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to change)
- [x] 🧹 Code refactor
- [ ] ✅ Build configuration change
- [ ] 📝 Documentation
- [ ] 🗑️ Chore

- `mobile/lib/screens/feed/video_feed_page.dart:259` and `mobile/lib/screens/feed/pooled_fullscreen_video_feed_screen.dart:586`: the new `FeedVideos` calls no longer pass `trafficSource` / `sourceDetail`, so `DivineVideoMetricsTracker` defaults view events to `ViewTrafficSource.unknown`. This regresses analytics attribution for both the home feed and contextual fullscreen feeds. On `origin/main`, the native `FeedVideos` branch passed `ViewTrafficSource.home`, and fullscreen passed `widget.trafficSource` / `widget.sourceDetail` through to both native and pooled metrics. After this refactor, every playback from these surfaces loses its source context. Please thread those props through the two `FeedVideos` calls and add/adjust a widget test that verifies the home feed uses `ViewTrafficSource.home` and fullscreen preserves the route args.

Verification I ran locally from `mobile/`:
- `flutter test test/screens/feed/video_feed_page_test.dart test/screens/feed/pooled_fullscreen_video_feed_screen_test.dart test/widgets/video_feed_item/feed_videos_test.dart`

Found one issue that I think should be fixed before merge.

- `mobile/packages/media_cache/lib/src/media_cache_image_provider.dart:149`: `operator ==` compares `authHeaders` by contents with `mapEquals`, but `hashCode` hashes the `MapEntry` objects from `authHeaders.entries`. `MapEntry` equality/hash is identity-based, so two providers with equal header maps can compare equal while producing different hash codes. Since this class is an `ImageProvider` key, that violates the key contract used by Flutter's `ImageCache` and can lead to duplicate/missed cache entries when callers pass equivalent header maps. Please hash headers by stable key/value pairs, for example sorted entries or `Object.hashAllUnordered(entries.map((e) => Object.hash(e.key, e.value)))`, and add a regression test for equal providers with separate but equal header maps.

Verification I ran locally from `mobile/`:
- `flutter test packages/media_cache/test/src/media_cache_image_provider_test.dart test/widgets/vine_cached_image_test.dart`

issue.title: feat(auth): add under-16 family guidance flow
issue.body:
Closes #3532

## Summary
This PR adds the client-side under-16 family guidance flow and the restricted-account review surfaces that route affected users into it.

## What Changed
- adds a welcome-screen entry point for under-16 family guidance
- adds the `/account-review` route family for welcome and moderation entry points
- adds a fail-closed checking route while authenticated moderation status is loading
- hard-gates restricted accounts to the allowed review, support, and moderation-message paths
- adds the public under-13 guidance screen and the restricted under-13 parent-support screen
- adds the 13-15 parent-consent screen and parent-contact submission screen
- sets the canonical support email to `support@divine.video`
- hosts family, kids, and age-review resources at paths on `divine.video` (e.g. `divine.video/family`) instead of separate subdomains
- fixes the support-email share fallback so the prepared body/instructions are preserved
- adds localized generic error states, Divine icon/accessibility cleanup, and focused widget/service tests

## Product Boundaries In This PR
- Under 13: parent or guardian must contact Divine support by email.
- Age 13 to 15: the parent or guardian email path is the supported handoff in this PR.
- This PR does not add private media upload, moderator tooling in other repos, or new backend review workflows.

- `mobile/lib/router/app_router.dart`

issue.title: refactor: replace mediakit with the new native-video-player
issue.body:
## Description

This PR replaces the old MediaKit video-player with the new DivineVideoPlayer which uses native-video-player apis.

Additionally, this PR fixes a brief flash of the paused/play overlay that appeared when scrolling to the next video in the feed. The `PausedVideoOverlay` now debounces the promotion of its "visible & paused" latch by 300 ms, so the transient `paused + firstFrameRendered` emission a pooled controller produces during a swipe no longer triggers the play affordance. A genuinely user-paused video still shows the play button after the short delay.

Closes #4684

## Out of Scope

None.

## Verification

- `flutter analyze lib/widgets/video_feed_item/paused_video_overlay.dart test/widgets/video_feed_item/paused_video_overlay_test.dart` — clean
- `flutter test test/widgets/video_feed_item/paused_video_overlay_test.dart` — passes
- Manual: swiping between videos in the feed no longer flashes the play overlay; pausing a video manually still surfaces it.

issue.body:
### What would you like?

The option to edit the speed of a clip is great. Can we get the option to reverse a clip? 



### How would this be useful for you?

For example I have a clip of me unzipping my jacket and would love to be able to duplicate it multiple times and reverse it so it looks like it I’m zipping up and unzipping my jacket over and over. 

### When would you use this?

When editing. Sometimes I go through my clips library and find bits of clips I didn’t use for my previous videos and add a weird audio to them to make funny edits. 

### Anything else?

issue.title: fix: profile video thumbnails not loading
issue.body:
### Summary

User profile thumbnails are no longer displayed in Discord, likely because VineCachedImage gets stuck when too many images load simultaneously.

### Environment

any

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Open the app and navigate to a user profile with many thumbnails.
2. Scroll quickly through all videos


### Actual Result

Some or all thumbnails remain blank and never finish loading.

### Expected Result

All thumbnails should load correctly and recover even under heavy parallel image loading.

### Regression?

Yes

### Evidence

Reported on discord [here](https://discord.com/channels/1470168817589158040/1470255950408454164/1507960191809884251)

release.body:
## Release Notes

Life in Loops got a bigger tune-up.

This update brings more tools for making loops your own: clip speed controls, timeline volume editing, local audio imports, audio extraction from clips, and a smoother post editing flow.

DMs got livelier too, with emoji reactions, lightweight markdown, better inbox previews, and sturdier message delivery. Profiles got banner uploads, verified account chips, cleaner text links, and better loading states.

We also added clip trash with 30-day recovery, sharper Explore and Popular filters, better search sorting, improved notifications, smoother feed playback, stronger upload/retry handling, and fixes across comments, invites, collabs, account recovery, and video metadata.

Short version: more creative control, better conversations, smoother feeds, fewer weird edges. Welcome Home.

## English (U.S.) - What to Test

Please focus on the new creator tools and everyday app flow:

- Edit a video with clip speed controls, clip volume, local audio import, and audio extraction.
- Try posting after changing metadata, tags, cover frame, collaborators, or engagement settings.
- Use DMs with emoji reactions, markdown, inbox previews, and message retry/recovery.
- Browse Home, Explore, Popular, search results, profiles, notifications, and comments.
- Try clip library sorting, deleting clips, and restoring from trash.
- Check account flows: sign in, account recovery, profile edits, NIP-05 settings, and returning to the app after closing it.

Please report anything that feels stuck, confusing, out of sync, loses edits, breaks playback, or shows stale counts/bad navigation.
